title: AstroHuh
label: AstroHuh
creator: Danny
creatorRole: who teaches the course Astrolabe came out of
promise: Something in Astrolabe made you go huh? Point at it, and AstroHuh drafts a report for Dan and Danny to read.

changes.note: Now called AstroHuh, started with /astrohuh. Before you say yes it tells you who reads the report, and it says plainly when your GitHub account can't file there.
First release: files Astrolabe confusions as GitHub issues from screenshots.
Reuses the 'Make it yours' in-place pattern without starting a new chat: drag-select crop on a Mac desktop, or paste a screenshot (works anywhere, including a phone), and names missing dependencies.

desc: Free, and part of the members' skills library. Something in Astrolabe made you go huh? Drag-select it on a Mac, or paste a screenshot (works anywhere, including a phone). AstroHuh finds where it lives in the code and drafts a GitHub issue. It goes to Astrolabe's GitHub issues, under your GitHub account, so filing needs an account with access to the Astrolabe repo. Dan and Danny read every one. Some can be fixed soon, some can't. You see the whole draft first, anything private gets cropped out, and nothing is sent until you say yes. Built on GitHub CLI gh (https://cli.github.com, MIT license) and screencapture on macOS.
bio: Danny teaches the course Astrolabe came out of. He built this to keep feedback loops frictionless without leaving the screen.

steps: add the AstroHuh skill to your notes folder, so every assistant has it
if Claude Code is here, also add the plugin marketplace goggledefogger/skills-town and install astrohuh
pin the AstroHuh button to your Astrolabe rituals shelf
install.updates: Auto-updates once that marketplace has it switched on; on any other agent, updating the skill file brings the next version.
install.touches: Adds the skill to your notes folder's skills, plus the Claude Code plugin if Claude Code is here, and a card to your Astrolabe rituals shelf. Reads captured screenshots in tools/screens and creates GitHub issues via gh. Writes nothing into your notes.
